form.label: Google Cloud / Workspace Audit - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed overview for Google Cloud AuditLog LogEntry and Google Workspace Reports Activity JSON relay events. Panels use fields proven by synthetic-equivalent fixtures plus Splunk JSON/search-time knowledge; this dashboard is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=main sourcetype="google:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ google_audit_family IN ("gcp_admin_activity","gcp_system_event","gcp_policy_denied","workspace_admin","workspace_token","workspace_groups","workspace_calendar","workspace_saml") | stats count
index=main sourcetype="google:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ google_audit_family IN ("gcp_data_access","workspace_drive") | stats count

index=main sourcetype="google:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | eval google_status=coalesce(status, severity) | where google_status!="0" OR match(upper(google_status), "ERROR|CRITICAL|ALERT|EMERGENCY") | stats count

panel.title: Events over time by Google audit family

search.query: index=main sourcetype="google:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | eval family=coalesce(google_audit_family, 'id.applicationName', "google_audit") | timechart count by family
index=main sourcetype="google:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | eval family=coalesce(google_audit_family, 'id.applicationName', "google_audit") | stats count by family | sort -count
index=main sourcetype="google:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | eval google_action=coalesce(action, method, mvindex('events{}.name',0)) | stats count by google_action | sort -count | head 20

index=main sourcetype="google:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | eval google_user=coalesce(user, src_user, 'protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail', 'actor.email') | stats count by google_user | sort -count | head 20
index=main sourcetype="google:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | eval caller_ip=coalesce(src_ip, src, 'protoPayload.requestMetadata.callerIp', ipAddress) | stats count by caller_ip | sort -count | head 20

panel.title: Google Cloud service and project coverage

search.query: index=main sourcetype="google:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ google_audit_family="gcp_*" | stats count by cloud_project gcp_service google_audit_family | sort -count | head 50

index=main sourcetype="google:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ google_audit_family="workspace_*" | eval workspace_event=coalesce(action, mvindex('events{}.name',0)) | stats count by app workspace_event workspace_oauth_app workspace_oauth_client_type workspace_group_email workspace_member_role workspace_calendar_access_level workspace_saml_application workspace_saml_failure_type | sort -count | head 50

index=main sourcetype="google:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ resource_name=* | table _time host google_audit_family user src_ip gcp_service method resource_name status gcp_permission gcp_permission_granted marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=main sourcetype="google:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ gcp_permission=* | eval grant_state=coalesce(gcp_permission_granted,"unknown") | stats count by grant_state gcp_permission gcp_service method cloud_project | sort grant_state -count | head 100

panel.title: Workspace OAuth, group, Calendar, and SAML access review

search.query: index=main sourcetype="google:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ google_audit_family IN ("workspace_token","workspace_groups","workspace_calendar","workspace_saml") | table _time host google_audit_family user src_ip action workspace_oauth_app workspace_oauth_client_id workspace_oauth_client_type workspace_group_email workspace_member_email workspace_member_role workspace_calendar_id workspace_calendar_access_level workspace_calendar_grantee_email workspace_saml_application workspace_saml_failure_type marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=main sourcetype="google:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | stats count dc(marker) as fixture_markers min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index sourcetype source host google_audit_family | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort -count

index=main sourcetype="google:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host google_audit_family cloud_project gcp_service method app user src_user src_ip action signature signature_id resource_name status gcp_permission gcp_permission_granted workspace_oauth_app workspace_oauth_client_id workspace_oauth_client_type workspace_group_email workspace_member_email workspace_member_role workspace_calendar_id workspace_calendar_access_level workspace_calendar_grantee_email workspace_saml_application workspace_saml_failure_type marker _raw | sort -_time | head 50
